ActiveExternalIp.description:
The external IP address sent in active mode (T11, T72). Not `Copy` (holds a URL).

JSON: `"auto"`, `{"fixed":"203.0.113.5"}` or `{"from_url":"http://…"}`.

oneOf.description: Ask the operating system for the local address.
Fetch the address from this `http://` URL (no default service).

Argon2Preset.description:
Argon2id cost preset for the vault (T30, T60). Parameters are owned by T30
(`Argon2Cost::from_preset`).

Association.description: One entry of `editing.associations`. First match wins (T63).

command.description:
Program and arguments, split with POSIX shell-word rules (`shell-words`).
`%f` is replaced by the file path; without `%f` the path is appended.

pattern.description:
Glob (`globset` syntax). Without `/` it matches the file name only,
with `/` it matches the full remote path. Always case-insensitive.

terminal.description: true: runs in this terminal (courier-ftp suspends); false: GUI, detached.

BurstTolerance.description: How far the speed limiter may burst above the limit (T44).

listing_cache_max_dirs.description: Directories kept in one global LRU across servers, 10–10000.

listing_cache_ttl_secs.description: Seconds a cached listing stays valid, 0–86400 (0 = until refreshed).

Column.description: A file list column (T53), in FileZilla's order.

ColumnSpec.description: One column of a file list and whether it is shown.

ConnectTarget.description: Where a connect request opens (T58, T59, T61).

ipv6.description: Use IPv6 addresses at all. FileZilla: "Disable IPv6" (inverted).

keepalive.description: Keep idle connections alive (FTP and SFTP). FileZilla: "Send FTP keep-alive commands".

keepalive_interval_secs.description: Idle seconds before a keep-alive is sent, 10–3600.

prefer_ipv6.description: Try IPv6 addresses first when connecting (Happy Eyeballs).

retries.description: Retries after a failed connection, 0–10. FileZilla: "Maximum number of retries".

retry_delay_secs.description: Seconds between retries, 0–600. FileZilla: "Delay between failed login attempts".

timeout_secs.description:
Inactivity timeout in seconds, 5–600. FileZilla: "Timeout in seconds" (FileZilla
allows 0 = off; courier-ftp always uses a timeout).

associations.description: FileZilla: "Filetype associations". First match wins; at most 256 entries.

editor.description:
FileZilla: "Default editor": `"auto"` ($VISUAL, $EDITOR, then the platform
default) or `{"command":{"command":"vim","terminal":true}}`.

max_size_mib.description:
Ask before downloading files larger than this many MiB for editing, 0–10240;
0 = never ask.

watch_and_prompt_upload.description: FileZilla: "Watch locally edited files and prompt to upload modifications".

terminal.description: true: runs in this terminal; false: GUI, detached.

EnterOnFile.description: What Enter does on a file (T51, T53).

ExistsAction.description:
What to do when a transfer target already exists (T04, T40, T42).

FileZilla: Settings → Transfers → File exists action.

oneOf.description: Overwrite if the source is newer.
Overwrite if the source is newer or the size differs.

ascii_extensions.description: FileZilla: "Treat the following filetypes as ASCII files" (lowercase, no dot).

no_extension_ascii.description: FileZilla: "Treat files without extension as ASCII file".

custom_script.description:
FileZilla: custom login sequence. `'\n'`-separated lines, used when kind is
`custom`; at most 32 lines of at most 512 characters.

host.description: FileZilla: "Proxy host". Required when kind is not `none`.

password_ref.description: FileZilla: "Pass" (`%w` in scripts), a `proxy-credential` vault item id.

active_external_ip.description:
FileZilla: "Active mode IP": `"auto"` (ask the OS), `{"fixed":"203.0.113.5"}` or
`{"from_url":"http://…"}` (an `http://` URL, at most 512 characters).

active_no_external_ip_on_local.description: FileZilla: "Don't use external IP address on local connections".

active_port_range.description: FileZilla: "Limit local ports used by FileZilla". null = OS ephemeral port.

fallback_to_active.description: FileZilla: "Allow fall back to other transfer mode on failure".

passive_ignore_unroutable_ip.description:
Use the control connection's peer address when PASV returns a private address.
FileZilla: "Use the server's external IP address instead".

send_keepalive_command.description: Keep-alive command: `noop` or `random` (NOOP, PWD or TYPE, as FileZilla does).

use_mlsd.description: Use MLSD for listings when the server lists it in FEAT.

host.description: FileZilla: "Proxy host". Required when kind is not `none`.

password_ref.description: FileZilla: "Proxy password", stored as a `proxy-credential` vault item; this is its id.

port.description: FileZilla: "Proxy port". 0 = the kind's default (HTTP 8080, SOCKS 1080).

user.description: FileZilla: "Proxy user". Empty = no authentication (SOCKS4: sent as user id).

check_prereleases.description: FileZilla: "Check for beta versions and release candidates".

columns.description: File list columns. Each column at most once; Name is always present and visible.

connect_target.description:
Where a connect request opens: `ask`, `new_tab` or `replace` (set by "remember my
choice").

date_format.description:
FileZilla: "Date/time format" (date part). Tokens `%Y %y %m %d %e %b %H %I %M %S %p
%%` plus literal text, at most 32 characters.

enter_on_file.description:
What Enter does on a file: `transfer`, `view`, `edit` or `none`. FileZilla: "Double-click
action on files".

key_sequence_timeout_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait for the next key of a key sequence (`gg`), 200–5000.

layout.description: FileZilla: "Layout of file and directory panes": `classic`, `explorer`, `widescreen`.

show_log.description: Show the message log (FileZilla: View → Message log).

show_queue.description: Show the transfer queue (FileZilla: View → Transfer queue).

show_quickconnect.description: Show the quickconnect bar (FileZilla: View → Quickconnect bar).

show_tree.description: Show the directory tree pane (FileZilla: View → Directory tree).

sort.description: Sort order of the file lists.

theme.description:
Colour theme: `default`, `high_contrast` or `monochrome` (`NO_COLOR` forces
monochrome). FileZilla: "Theme".

time_format.description: FileZilla: "Date/time format" (time part). Same tokens as `date_format`.

KeepaliveCommand.description: The command sent as an FTP keep-alive (T10).

oneOf.description: `NOOP`, `PWD` or `TYPE` picked at random per keep-alive (FileZilla behaviour).

log_file_max_mib.description: FileZilla: "Limit size of logfile" in MiB, 1–1024.

pane_max_lines.description: Lines kept in the message log pane, 500–100000.

NotifyMethod.description: How the user is notified when the queue has finished (T45).

oneOf.description: OSC 9 / 777 desktop notification (some terminals print the sequence).

OnComplete.description: Action when the queue has finished (T45). Sound, sleep and shutdown are dropped (D8).

PaneColumns.description: The columns of both file lists, in display order (T53).

local.description: Local file list. Unknown column names are skipped.

remote.description: Remote file list. Unknown column names are skipped.

PaneSort.description: Sort order of both file lists (saved on quit, T53).

ProxySettings.description:
`proxy`. Proxy passwords are never settings: they are `proxy-credential` vault items
referenced by `password_ref`.

ftp_proxy.description: FileZilla: Connection → FTP → FTP Proxy. Cannot be used with the generic proxy.

max_successful.description: Successful transfers kept in the "Successful transfers" tab, 0–100000.

notify.description: Notification when the queue is done: `none`, `bell` or `osc`.

on_complete_command.description: FileZilla: "Run command"; used when `on_complete` is `run_command`, ≤ 1024 chars.

persist.description: Keep the queue across restarts (encrypted, device-local).

refresh_remote_after.description: Refresh the remote listing after the queue finished uploads.

SegmentedSettings.description: `transfers.segmented` (T41b): large files split over several connections.

max_segments.description: Segments per file, 1–16 (1 = off for practical purposes).

min_file_size_mib.description: Only files of at least this many MiB are split, 1–1048576.

max_outstanding_requests.description:
Pipelined requests per open file, 1–256 (the effective value is also capped at
8 MiB / request size).

request_size.description:
Bytes per read/write request, 4096–261120, when the server sends no
`limits@openssh.com` (else the server's value, capped at 261120).

use_openssh_known_hosts.description: Also trust host keys from the OpenSSH known_hosts files (read-only).

SizeFormat.description: How file sizes are shown (T53, T56, T57).

SortSpec.description: Sort order of one file list.

poll_fallback_secs.description: Seconds between polls when live updates are unavailable, 30–3600.

push_debounce_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after a change before pushing, 100–60000.

empty_dirs.description: Empty directories in recursive transfers: `create` or `skip`.

follow_symlinks.description: Follow symbolic links in recursive operations.

invalid_char_replacement.description:
FileZilla: "Replace invalid characters with". Not one of `\ / : * ? " < > |`, `.`,
space or a control character.

max_downloads.description: FileZilla: "Limit for concurrent downloads", 0 (no separate limit) to max_concurrent.

max_uploads.description: FileZilla: "Limit for concurrent uploads", 0 (no separate limit) to max_concurrent.

on_exists_download.description: FileZilla: "Default file exists action" for downloads.

on_exists_upload.description: FileZilla: "Default file exists action" for uploads.

speed_limit_enabled.description: FileZilla: "Enable speed limits" (also toggled from the status bar).

TransferTypeChoice.description:
The transfer type the user chose; `Auto` is resolved per file by
[`decide_transfer_type`](super::decide_transfer_type) (T11, T40, T57).

UnicodeSymbols.description: Whether Unicode symbols are drawn (T50, T57).

oneOf.description: Detect from the terminal and locale.

argon2_cost.description:
Argon2id cost: `light`, `standard` or `strong`; applied at the next password
change or unlock re-wrap.

auto_lock_minutes.description: Lock the vault after this many idle minutes, 0–1440 (0 = off).

lock_disconnects.description: Locking the vault also disconnects all sessions.

lock_on_suspend.description: Lock the vault when the system suspends.

description: All settings. A partial user object works: every section and field has a default.

connection.description: Connection timeouts, retries, keep-alive and IPv6 (FileZilla: Connection).

editing.description: External editors and file associations (FileZilla: File editing).

file_types.description: ASCII / binary detection (FileZilla: Transfers → FTP: File Types).

ftp.description: FTP transfer mode, active mode and listing options (FileZilla: Connection → FTP).

interface.description: Layout, file lists, date formats and confirmations (FileZilla: Interface).

logging.description: Message log and log file (FileZilla: Logging, Debug).

proxy.description: Generic and FTP proxies (FileZilla: Connection → Generic proxy / FTP → FTP Proxy).

queue.description: Queue completion actions and persistence (FileZilla: Transfers → queue).

sftp.description: SFTP pipelining and host key sources (FileZilla: Connection → SFTP).

sync.description: Device sync tuning. The server URL and tokens are not settings.

transfers.description: Parallel transfers, speed limits, file-exists actions (FileZilla: Transfers).

vault.description: Vault locking and key derivation cost (FileZilla: Interface → Passwords).

title: courier-ftp settings
